recentItems.title: "I Was Just Mesmerized" Jeffrey Donovan & Deborah Ann Woll on ‘The Cycle’
recentItems.description:
Deborah Ann Woll, Jeffrey Donovan, and director/co-writer Jordan Downey sit down with Fandango correspondent Mark Ellis to talk about their chilling horror flick, ‘The Cycle’!  They talk about their excitement premiering their picture at Fantastic Fest 2026 and seeing the audience’s reactions.  They talk about how special the film was, from the story, to the practical effects during production, to the special effects in post.  And, on top of geeking out about their own film, they share some of the film, television, and more that are exciting them.  See ‘The Cycle’ streaming on Shudder October 23!
